primitive.relation: two contracts under the corpus name "eulerian". DIRECTED degree balance of a finite digraph (every vertex has equal in- and out-degree; canonical Digraph.foundations.degree_balance.balanced): two_extremal.Eulerian (forall v, indeg v = outdeg v over classic_core.indeg) is balanced D by conversion; colouring_variants.eulerian ([forall v, indeg v == outdeg v], Boolean, file-local in-degree) is balancedb D by conversion, reflected by balancedP; X221.x221_eulerian (forall v, outdeg v = indeg v) is the reversed-equation view balanced_revE, a proved iff. UNDIRECTED Eulerian multigraph (connected over all vertices through base's uwalk, every arc-end degree even, a loop counting two; the empty multigraph and an isolated vertex qualify; canonical Cycle.foundations.eulerian.eulerian over Cycle.foundations.connectivity, B17): Cycle.U6.eulerian (mconnected G /\ forall v : G, ~~ odd (mdeg v)) is that canonical by conversion. The two contracts share only the name: no bridge between them is stated. Deferred: reals_growth.eulerian (same directed body, but its two non-corpus EC-log rows inherit classical-reals axioms through their statements: a legacy-axiom defect, left byte-identical). Distinct and untouched: U6.is_eulerian_tour (a supplied DIRECTED closed walk using every edge once; not migrated, no tour equivalence), U6.even_subgraph (even degrees of a supplied edge set, disconnected allowed) and Chromatic.foundations.alon_tarsi.at_eulerian (balance of a supplied finite set of ordered pairs).

legacy-axiom-defect.note: reals_growth.eulerian (forall v : D, indeg v = outdeg v over its file-local in-degree) has the body of balanced D, but it is NOT migrated: its two non-corpus EC-log rows (ec_log_statement, ec_log_c6_statement) inherit four classical-reals axioms (ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_not_dec, sig_forall_dec, FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep, Classical_Prop.classic) through their statements, so any certificate of them fails the kernel assumptions audit required by the plan (section 3, invariant 4). reals_growth.v and grounding_reals2.v stay byte-identical to the baseline; the rejected pin 6dba7ed and its evidence record the attempt. Classified as a deferred legacy-axiom defect, not migrated and not accepted; the kernel evidence re-probes that neither EC-log statement reaches a migrated source or the public module.

prop-degree-balance.note: forall v : D, indeg v = outdeg v with classic_core.indeg = #|Nin v| = #|[set u | u --> v]|: the body of balanced D, convertible. Its corpus row H6_no_full_cover (derived:drv_twoext_h6, phase X1) is frozen complete with every guard in order; its chains realises_Eulerian (Section-parametric in the realisation relation, discharged type explicit), realises_W, realises_E and realises_gw and the two whole non-selected Conjecture 9.2 encodings conj_9_2_glued / conj_9_2_glued_e are frozen over the frozen helper and certified by complete iffs.

prop-degree-balance-reversed.note: forall v : D, outdeg v = indeg v with classic_core.indeg = #|Nin v| = #|[set u | u --> v]|: the reversed equation; equivalent to balanced D by balanced_revE (eq_sym pointwise), a proved iff, not a conversion.

bool-degree-balance.note: [forall v : D, indeg v == outdeg v] with colouring_variants' local indeg: the body of balancedb D, convertible; balancedP reflects it into balanced D.

multigraph-eulerian.note: Cycle U6's eulerian G := mconnected G /\ forall v : G, ~~ odd (mdeg v) on an mgraph read as an UNDIRECTED multigraph: connected over ALL vertices (base's uwalk, orientation-free) with every arc-end degree even (a loop counts two). It is the body of the canonical Cycle.foundations.eulerian.eulerian (B17), convertible; a different contract from the directed degree balance of the other classes, sharing only the corpus name. Its three complete OPG rows (decomposing_an_eulerian_graph_into_cycles, ..._with_no_tw, decomposing_eulerian_graphs) are frozen in Cycle.migration.eulerian with every guard (positive counts, simple_mgraph, minimum arc-end degree 4, the supplied directed is_eulerian_tour, edge_connected 6, the supplied transition system). is_eulerian_tour and even_subgraph are NOT migrated; no tour equivalence or extra nonempty/loopless guard is stated.

upstream_audit.note: coq-graph-theory has no in/out-degree of a finite digraph. The Digraph core has outdeg (core/oriented.v) but no in-degree outside conjecture files (classic_core.indeg over Nin, and two file-local copies in colouring_variants and reals_growth) and no balance predicate. The new public Digraph.foundations.degree_balance owns indeg, balanced and balancedb with the reflection, the reversed view, the converse swap, the handshake sum and arcless balance; outdeg and the three local in-degrees are unchanged. Chromatic.foundations.alon_tarsi.at_eulerian counts the incoming and outgoing arcs of a supplied finite set of ordered pairs (no digraph, no connectivity): a distinct representation, deferred. Closed Eulerian tours, strong connectivity and the undirected multigraph notion stay separate. Legacy bodies and per-row certificates: meta/migration_reports/degree_balance.md. B17 (undirected contract): the pinned coq-graph-theory sources have no Eulerian predicate (case-insensitive search of every .v), base owns uwalk and Cycle.foundations.connectivity owns mconnected, subdeg and mdeg; the new public Cycle.foundations.eulerian is the focused adapter over them (projections, introduction, Boolean even-degree reflection, groundings on the empty multigraph, an isolated vertex, loops, parallel arcs, a single edge and disconnected even carriers). GTBase cannot import Cycle, so the canonical stays in cycle-theory.
